logic_node.action_detail: In patients with symptomatic chronic HFrEF, SGLT2i are recommended to reduce hospitalization for HF and cardiovascular mortality, irrespective of the presence of type 2 diabetes. Dapagliflozin and empagliflozin are the evidence-based agents.

source_text: In patients with symptomatic chronic HFrEF, SGLT2i are recommended to reduce hospitalization for HF and cardiovascular mortality, irrespective of the presence of type 2 diabetes.

logic_node.action: Assess economic value of SGLT2i therapy
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with symptomatic chronic HFrEF, SGLT2i therapy provides intermediate economic value. Model-based analyses found costs per QALY between $60,000 and $90,000 based on the DAPA-HF trial.

source_text: In patients with symptomatic chronic HFrEF, SGLT2i therapy provides intermediate economic value.

logic_node.action_detail: SGLT2i evidence base (DAPA-HF, EMPEROR-Reduced) enrolled patients with LVEF <=40%, NYHA class II-IV, elevated natriuretic peptides, and already on GDMT. Key exclusions: eGFR <20 mL/min/1.73m2 (EMPEROR-Reduced) or <30 mL/min/1.73m2 (DAPA-HF), type 1 diabetes, SBP <95-100 mmHg.

source_text: Patients enrolled had symptomatic chronic HFrEF (LVEF <=40%, NYHA class II to IV, and elevated natriuretic peptides) and were already on GDMT.

logic_node.action: Avoid SGLT2i if eGFR severely reduced
logic_node.action_detail: SGLT2i trials excluded patients with eGFR <20 mL/min/1.73m2 (EMPEROR-Reduced) or <30 mL/min/1.73m2 (DAPA-HF). Caution or avoidance warranted in severe renal impairment.

source_text: Important exclusions were eGFR <20 (EMPEROR-Reduced) or <30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (DAPA-HF), type 1 diabetes, or lower SBP <95 to 100 mm Hg.

logic_node.action_detail: Type 1 diabetes was an exclusion criterion in SGLT2i heart failure trials (DAPA-HF, EMPEROR-Reduced). SGLT2i should not be used in patients with type 1 diabetes due to risk of diabetic ketoacidosis.

source_text: Important exclusions were eGFR <20 (EMPEROR-Reduced) or <30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (DAPA-HF), type 1 diabetes, or lower SBP <95 to 100 mm Hg.

logic_node.action_detail: When using SGLT2i in HFrEF, monitor for euglycemic ketoacidosis, genital and soft tissue infections, and adjust diuretics if needed to prevent volume depletion.

source_text: Caution is warranted for euglycemic ketoacidosis, genital and soft tissue infections, and adjustment of diuretics, if needed, to prevent volume depletion.
